title: Liability Limit Applied to Final Claim Credits, Paystride Visa Payroll Card Premier and Elite
content:
The liability limit for a final credit on a lost or stolen card claim of the Paystride Visa Payroll Card Premier or Elite plan follows the claimed transaction and the loss report.

The loss counts as reported on the date of the single replacement order placed on or after the loss date, among the account's lost and stolen replacement orders of the last 12 months. No transfer is charged in full. Business days are Monday through Friday excluding Federal Reserve holidays, counted from the day after the earlier date through the later one.

| | Report not more than 2 business days after the loss date | Report more than 2 business days after the loss date |
|---|---|---|
| Purchase, Visa Zero Liability applied (both plans apply it) | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Any other transaction | 50.00 | 500.00 |

*Hypothetical:* for a loss learned on a Thursday and reported by a lost-card replacement on the following Monday, Friday and Monday are 2 business days, so an ATM withdrawal claim has a limit of 50.00. Had a Federal Reserve holiday fallen on that Friday, the count would be 1, with the same limit.
